systems.owner: Ministry of Health; in Maracha district implemented with UNCDF and BRAC Uganda
systems.tiers: Village Health Teams; in Maracha since 2021 across 1,382 VHTs supervised by 182 community health extension workers

note: The only health system named is eCHIS, a community-class system, so no fact is taken; the document reports Maracha's VHT reporting rate on it falling from 75% to about 15% as external support ended with the UNCDF programme's close on 26 August 2026.
